ZinVectors.Semantics: Arithmetic and bitwise operations are lane-wise compiler-defined primitive semantics and are not operator overloading.
ZinVectors.Lowering: Use native SIMD instructions when target features allow. Otherwise scalarization is permitted if observable semantics are identical.
ZinVectors.TargetFeatures: SIMD code may only emit instructions enabled by the compilation target or function-level required feature set.
